name: quintet
description: Unified CLI-agent orchestrator. Drives Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Gemini, GitHub Copilot, and Qwen Code CLIs in two modes: persistent tmux worker teams and one-shot multi-AI fleet dispatch / debate / review.

interface.shortDescription: Orchestrate five coding-agent CLIs as one fleet.
interface.longDescription: Quintet drives Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Gemini, GitHub Copilot, and Qwen Code through one entry point, in two modes: persistent tmux worker teams that edit files in parallel, and one-shot fleet dispatch for consult / debate / multi-model code review with a circuit-breaker reliability layer.
defaultPrompt: Use Quintet to run codex, gemini, and claude on this task in parallel.
Use Quintet to debate gRPC vs REST across the models and synthesize a recommendation.
Use Quintet to spin up a tmux worker team to build this feature.
